traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Picrodendraceae: leaves alternate; leaves compound; margins entire; veins pinnate; leaves deciduous; stipules present; plants dioecious; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers solitary, in panicles or in catkins; perianth absent or tepals; fruit drupe; stamens 20 to 70; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
